newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Asia product tender summary- Taiwan seeks fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Asia product tender summary- Taiwan seeks fuel oil.

text.p: TAIWAN B 2X38KT LOW-POUR FUEL OIL, ONE 1.0-PCT CARGO AND THE OTHER 0.5-PCT FOR SECOND HALF SEPT. CLS AUG 6 VALID TWO DAYS. TAIWAN B 250KB 95-OCTANE UNL REFORMATE FOR SEPT 1-15 C+F KEELUNG/KAOHSIUNG/SHALUNG/TAICHUNG, CLSES JUL 29 VALID JUL 31. ***cancelled due to high offers.
